generations.prompt: Morning at a dusty crossroads by a wayside stone cross. A medieval jongleur in a ragged red-and-blue parti-coloured tunic and a battered felt hat with a feather juggles five leather balls high in the air beside the road, grinning, performing to no one; he catches them all one by one, bows deeply to the empty road with a flourish of the hat, then plants his hands on the ground and kicks up into a steady handstand with his legs straight, the hat tumbling off; behind him a goatherd with a staff and three goats walks past without turning his head and out of frame; the scruffy dog sits in the dust watching and yawns. Camera level, nearly static. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
